'''Skinkner''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] syndicate and could be found in a [[Kor Vella Cantina|cantina]] in [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Skinkner was a member of the [[Brommstaad Mercenaries]]. [[Zekka Thyne]] sent him to capture [[Haber Trell]]'s cargo at the dewback storage facility in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
